name: SquadPy
author: noreply@example.com
description: Installs and runs SquadPy (Python framework for Squad server management).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

apt update
apt -y install --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Avoid git safety failures on reinstalls when ownership changes across container users.
git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server || true
git config --system --add safe.directory /mnt/server || true

if [[ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]]; then
  echo "GIT_ADDRESS is required."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
  GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"
fi

if [[ -n "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
  export GIT_USERNAME="${GIT_USERNAME:-x-access-token}"
  cat > /tmp/git-askpass.sh <<'ASKPASS'
#!/bin/sh
case "$1" in
  *Username*) printf '%s\n' "${GIT_USERNAME}" ;;
  *Password*) printf '%s\n' "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ;;
  *) printf '\n' ;;
esac
ASKPASS
  chmod 700 /tmp/git-askpass.sh
  export GIT_ASKPASS=/tmp/git-askpass.sh
  echo "Using token-based git authentication."
fi

if [[ -d .git ]]; then
  echo "Existing git repository detected. Pulling latest branch state."
  git -c safe.directory=/mnt/server remote set-url origin "${GIT_ADDRESS}"
  git -c safe.directory=/mnt/server fetch --depth 1 origin "${GIT_BRANCH:-master}"
  git -c safe.directory=/mnt/server checkout -B "${GIT_BRANCH:-master}" FETCH_HEAD
else
  if [[ -n "$(ls -A /mnt/server 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
    echo "/mnt/server is not empty and is not a git repo; refusing to overwrite files."
    exit 10
  fi
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH:-master}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /mnt/server
fi

mkdir -p config config/plugins logs data .pterodactyl

cp -n config/server.toml.example config/server.toml || true
cp -n config/logging.toml.example config/logging.toml || true
cp -n config/database.toml.example config/database.toml || true

for plugin in auto_kick_unassigned admin_request discord_chat_bridge plugin_manager server_status tk_warn; do
  if [[ -f "config/plugins/${plugin}.toml.example" ]]; then
    cp -n "config/plugins/${plugin}.toml.example" "config/plugins/${plugin}.toml" || true
  fi
done

cat > /mnt/server/.pterodactyl/startup.sh <<'STARTUP'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /home/container
mkdir -p config config/plugins logs data

if [[ ! -f config/server.toml ]]; then
  echo "Missing config/server.toml. This egg does not auto-generate runtime TOML files."
  echo "Copy config/server.toml.example to config/server.toml and edit values."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -d .venv ]]; then
  python3 -m venv .venv
fi

source .venv/bin/activate

deps_hash_input=""
if [[ -f pyproject.toml ]]; then
  deps_hash_input+="$(sha256sum pyproject.toml | awk '{print $1}')"
fi
if [[ -f requirements.txt ]]; then
  deps_hash_input+="$(sha256sum requirements.txt | awk '{print $1}')"
fi
deps_hash="$(printf '%s' "${deps_hash_input}" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
stored_hash="$(cat .venv/.deps_hash 2>/dev/null || true)"

if [[ "${deps_hash}" != "${stored_hash}" ]]; then
  python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
  pip install -e .
  printf '%s' "${deps_hash}" > .venv/.deps_hash
fi

exec python -m squadpy
STARTUP

chmod +x /mnt/server/.pterodactyl/startup.sh

echo "Install complete. Edit config/*.toml as needed, then start the server."
